authorization: Parent approved explicit stronger gate before collection
acceptance: Every pair in every primary cell must reduce diagnostic peak requested frame-buffer capacity by at least 50 percent; aggregate statistics cannot hide a failing pair
materialization: For each primary new-arm encode, tracked initial headers equal retained recipe frames plus one spare header, or zero for Raw. No losing candidate frame materialization is accepted.
lifetime: All tracked buffers freed after recipe drop, registry success, and frees equal initial allocations plus reallocations
measurement_limit: Diagnostic allocate-copy-free policy includes actual old/new overlap; not production System realloc or process RSS
